song_craft: Voice: stotra-address couplets — Abhinavagupta’s own hymn, first person throughout, vocatives load-bearing every verse (row 7). Arc: veneration-by-becoming (v1) → two-step recognition (v2) → fear-denied-suffering-kept (v3) → death defied (v4) → fearlessness finished (v5) → awakening→ingress (v6) → affliction-as-occasion (v7) → rites relativized (v8) → dancing consciousness (v9) → dated seal cooling the world (v10). Recognition performed, not argued. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: All this, become Yours without remainder, now appears to me by the power of Your grace.
You, Maheśa, are ever my own self — made of You, all is mine through You.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvanmayam etad aśeṣam idānīṃ bhāti mama tvadanugrahaśaktyā tvaṃ ca maheśa sadaiva mamātmā svātmamayaṃ mama tena samastam
notes: svātmamaya kept constitutive (‘made of You’), not identity — see NOTE boundary

verses.craft: Two-step recognition (disclosure then declaration); svātmamaya constitutive per NOTE-boundary; tena open kept open.
verses.rejected: (a) identity reading → killed by NOTE. (b) resolving tena → killed by UNC.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'svātmamaya' means 'made of my self' or 'self-identical' is unresolved.", "Whether 'tena' refers to grace or to Maheśa is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa śānta (tranquility) with adbhuta (wonder) / L2+L3 voice
